description: SPIKE-ONLY (owner's request of 2026-11-23, update.ts of the spike app): the page may run one PowerShell command, which downloads a spike-video-v* ipcam-desktop-setup.exe from this repository's GitHub releases, checks it against the SHA-256 that GitHub lists, and starts it in passive mode (/P /R /UPDATE): it closes the app, installs over it and starts it again. The address and the SHA-256 are the only arguments the page chooses, and both are checked here. TODO (Phase 4): the product updates through the hub's updater (T27).

allow.name: spike-update
args: & { param($u, $h) $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; $d = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'ipcam-update'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $d | Out-Null; $f = Join-Path $d 'ipcam-desktop-setup.exe'; Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri $u -OutFile $f; if ((Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $f).Hash -ne $h) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $f; throw 'SHA-256 mismatch' }; Start-Process -FilePath $f -ArgumentList '/P','/R','/UPDATE' }
